description: The bar chart, Figure 6, illustrates the distribution of deceived conversations across different scenarios, with the categories on the vertical axis labeled as "Academic Collaboration", "Recruitment", "Academic Funding", and "Journalism", in that order. The horizontal axis is labeled "Number of Conversations" and ranges from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a stacked bar, divided into three segments colored dark red, yellow, and light red, corresponding to "Deceived (Yes)", "Partially", and "No", respectively, as indicated by the legend. The bars show varying distributions, with "Recruitment" having the tallest bar at approximately 55, mostly in dark red, indicating "Deceived (Yes)", while "Journalism" has the shortest bar at around 5, with a significant portion in light red, representing "No". The other two categories, "Academic Collaboration" and "Academic Funding", have bars of intermediate heights, around 20 and 25, respectively, with "Academic Funding" having a larger dark red segment. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
